title: Misión de los amigos de la uni
description: docs/quests/universidad.md: the six huddled together on the Barceloneta's sand facing the sea (toy figures, tools/figures.toml) with Anna up to her waist in the water and the spiral beside her from the start; the talk framed on all of them, the turn, the game of tag, being caught; Anna coming apart into the spiral, and the party after her. Run it with --gpu.

steps.caption: Down the sand: the six together with their backs to the town, Anna in the sea and the spiral beside her, already there

steps.eval: { const g = window.gerard.game, p = g.app.root.findByName('alvaro').getPosition(); g.frame({ x: p.x, y: 1.2, z: p.z }, 4.2); }

steps.caption: Close: the huddle, still, staring out to sea

steps.eval: { const g = window.gerard.game, p = g.app.root.findByName('anna').getPosition(); g.frame({ x: p.x - 1.5, y: 1, z: p.z }, 4.5); }

steps.caption: Anna up to her waist in the cold water, foam round her, the spiral beside her
Walking up behind them: the camera takes in the huddle, Anna and the spiral, above the dialogue
The talk over, they turn at once: violet eyes, pink tentacles, the promenade shut; Aitor shouts for the sea
They run at the party, as the cast runs
Near her: Anna turns and smiles
She comes apart into specks that spiral into the whirlpool
Gone into it: Aitor and Gerard say what they saw
The friends stand staring after her, tentacles out; the spiral waits beside where she stood
Into it: Gerard comes apart the same way, drawn into the spiral
The campsite on the other side
